mainEntity.name: When should my business consider implementing topic clusters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your business should consider implementing topic clusters when you have a significant amount of existing content that could benefit from better organization, or when you're looking to establish deeper topical authority in your niche. It's particularly beneficial if you're struggling with keyword cannibalization, stagnant organic traffic, or if your competitors are outranking you for broad industry terms. Businesses aiming for long-term SEO growth and a more efficient content marketing strategy will find topic clusters highly valuable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Implement topic clusters if you have disorganized content, want to build topical authority, are experiencing keyword cannibalization, or aim for long-term SEO growth.
